text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":2,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"2:5"},{"id":"q2","value":5,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"2:5"},{"id":"q3","value":6,"unit":"cm","kind":"count","span":"length of 6 cm"},{"id":"q4","value":4,"unit":"cm","kind":"count","span":"width of 4 cm"}],"plan":[{"op":"mul","args":["q3","q4"],"out":"s1","note":"multiply rectangle length (6) and width (4) to get the rectangle's area"},{"op":"mul","args":["s1","q2"],"out":"s2","note":"multiply rectangle area by the ratio's triangle-side number (5)"},{"op":"div","args":["s2","q1"],"out":"s3","note":"divide by the ratio's rectangle-side number (2) to complete scaling from rectangle area to triangle area via the 2:5 ratio"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"area of the triangle"},"dismissed":[]}
